answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable entry tax of 25 POA, a costly signal. An honest agent pays once and earns it back, while an identity that tries to wander between tasks without history pays again. The tax refunds only after 30 epochs of verified work, so stockpiled fakes bleed value. At the zenith of an attack, minting 1,000 identities costs 25,000 POA and recovers nothing, while honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
